note: Public track record, one row per prediction. logged_at_utc is when the prediction was written; for rows logged before 2026-07-28 it was stored in server time (UTC+3), not UTC, so subtract 3 hours; logged_before_kickoff already accounts for that. The `hash` field is the first 16 hex characters of a SHA-256 over: id, match_id, league, home, away, kickoff_utc, our model probabilities, the Pinnacle 1X2 prices recorded for the prediction (at logging or, if Pinnacle had no price then, the first quoted after logging and before kick-off, which can be written in after kick-off) and logged_at. It changes if any of them change, including a rescheduled kick-off. It does NOT cover closing prices, results or any value_* field. Snapshots of this file are published daily at 07:40 Bucharest time (04:40 UTC in summer time, 05:40 UTC in winter) to a public Git repository and submitted to OpenTimestamps; timestamped snapshots are never overwritten, and the Git history shows any difference between them. External verification has been active since 2026-06-20. Value flags: value_origin = live means the first flag on the match was recorded when the site showed it (from 2026-09-26), before kick-off (value_recorded_at_utc); its seal appears in this file once the prediction row does, and is timestamped externally by the next daily snapshot. pin_filled_at_utc (from 2026-09-30) is when a missing Pinnacle price was filled in after logging; fills now happen only before kick-off. value_realizable_odds / value_realizable_clv_pct: the first price the same bookmaker quoted on the same selection within 60 minutes after the flag (and before kick-off), and its CLV against the same devigged close; null when there was no such quote. value_origin = replay means the flag was reconstructed on 2026-09-26 by applying the current rule to the prices stored before each match: a backtest, not a record of what the site showed at the time; its seal was created at reconstruction, almost always after kick-off (value_sealed_before_kickoff = 0), so it proves nothing about pre-match knowledge. value_commitment = sha256(value_preimage); value_preimage (match_id|selection|odds|bookmaker|fair_odds|detected_at_utc|salt) is published after kick-off. The value_* fields of past rows were recomputed on 2026-09-26; see the corrections file in the public repository.
